objective: Implement and demonstrate the complete CW-05 G4 feasibility boundary on the integrated G1-G3 candidate.
required_behavior: Build a minimal backend/frontend lifetime split owning two real OMP PTYs, one parent shell PTY, and a distinct experiment supervisor identity; detach for more than 60 seconds and reattach without PID/control/user-owner changes or duplicate processes.

Drive a real 60-second timer wake through the worker OMP exactly once while detached, using a bounded approval fixture; prove a closed pause port prevents model delivery while host experiment observation continues.
Provide a minimal metadata port whose durable-write success permits dispatch and whose injected failure holds new dispatch without terminating the existing run.

Add versioned Python and TypeScript contracts/adapters for ShellControl, Takeover, DeliveryObservation, AutomationState, and ResumeEvidence; preserve v1 compatibility, reject unsupported old versions, and test cross-language fixtures.
Record selected runtime/dependency source, hash/version, license, and install command in G4 documentation.

Provide a gate aggregate validator that rejects missing owned items, changed requirements/approval/candidate identity, insufficient evidence level, failed checks, required unknowns, and fixture-only evidence for runtime items; accept only a valid G1-G4 set tied to current integrated inputs.
Use actual OMP 18.2.10 for runtime claims, bounded cleanup, PTY/pipe drain, and residue checks. Do not claim CW-09/11/12/15 production completion.
constraints: Preserve all existing user and G1-G3 changes; do not reset, clean, stash, commit, push, or deploy.
Do not modify PLAN, BRIEF, SPEC, tickets, workflow records, graphify output, or implement downstream production features.
Keep the implementation minimal and make fixture/diagnostic behavior explicit rather than presenting it as production durability.
checks: Run focused Python and Node contract tests.
Run the actual >60-second detach/wake/reconnect probe and paused control case.
Run negative evidence-validator cases and an integrated valid-set case.
Run relevant G1-G4 regression tests and git diff --check.
report: exact runtime command, environment, elapsed detach interval, PIDs/identities and wake/pause observations
contract compatibility, metadata failure, dependency and evidence-validator results
